stories.title: Cruz Azul pierde con Monterrey por un error de Kevin Mier y cierra una semana para el olvido

en.title: Cruz Azul loses to Monterrey due to Kevin Mier error and closes a week to forget
en.summary: Cruz Azul suffered a painful 1-0 defeat at Monterrey's stadium after a mistake by goalkeeper Kevin Mier during a difficult week for the team.

stories.title: Condena error a Cruz Azul en su visita a Rayados

en.title: Error condemns Cruz Azul in their visit to Rayados
en.summary: Cruz Azul lost 1-0 to Monterrey's Rayados in a match decided by goalkeeper Kevin Mier's mistake, concluding a forgettable week.

stories.title: Asesinan a Susy Aponte, periodista y candidata a gobernadora en Perú

en.title: Susy Aponte, journalist and gubernatorial candidate in Peru, is murdered
en.summary: A candidate for governor of Áncash region in Peru was killed during an attack at a market that injured five other people, with one suspect detained.

stories.title: Asesinan a periodista y candidata a elecciones regionales en Perú; ataque dejó cinco personas heridas

en.title: Journalist and regional election candidate murdered in Peru; attack leaves five people injured
en.summary: A candidate for Áncash department who ran an online news portal reporting on alleged police irregularities was killed in an attack that wounded five others.

stories.title: Necaxa cae ante Atlético de San Luis en el debut de Juan Reynoso

en.title: Necaxa falls to Atlético de San Luis in Juan Reynoso's debut
en.summary: Necaxa lost 3-1 to Atlético de San Luis in Matchday 9 of the Apertura 2026 season, despite taking an early lead through a goal by Julián Carranza.

stories.title: Pumas deja escapar la victoria y empata con Atlas en el redebut del Chino Huerta

en.title: Pumas lets victory slip away and draws with Atlas in Chino Huerta's return
en.summary: Pumas failed to preserve their lead against Atlas and drew the match, squandering a victory that appeared to be secured.

stories.title: Alcaldía Xochimilco también participa en el Simulacro Nacional 2026; "el día de hoy ya hay más gente capacitada": rescatista

en.title: Xochimilco Mayor's Office also participates in National Drill 2026; "today there are already more trained people": rescuer
en.summary: Xochimilco Mayor's Office participated in the National Drill 2026 by conducting four rescue scenarios covering high-altitude operations, building collapses, vehicle accidents, and fires.

stories.title: Así participaron los estados en el Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026; reportan saldo blanco

en.title: This is how states participated in the Second National Drill 2026; report zero incidents
en.summary: States participated in the Second National Drill 2026, an exercise aimed at promoting civil protection and disaster prevention awareness without reporting serious incidents.

stories.title: Participan 33 millones de mexicanos en Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026, reporta la CNPC; hospitalizan a una persona por infarto

en.title: 33 million Mexicans participate in Second National Drill 2026, reports CNPC; one person hospitalized for heart attack
en.summary: A national earthquake drill involved 33 million Mexican participants, with civil protection authorities reporting one hospitalization for a heart attack and another person receiving medical attention after a fall in Mexico City.

stories.title: Simulacro Nacional 2026: alerta sísmica funciona en 98.93% de altavoces de CDMX

en.title: National Drill 2026: seismic alert functions in 98.93% of speakers in Mexico City
en.summary: Mexico City's seismic alert system operated successfully on 98.93 percent of speakers during a national drill simulating a 7.7 magnitude earthquake, with an average evacuation time of one minute and 43 seconds.

stories.title: Sheinbaum agradece participación en el Simulacro Nacional 2026: "La prevención es nuestra fuerza"

en.title: Sheinbaum thanks participation in 2026 National Drill: "Prevention is our strength"
en.summary: Mexico's president acknowledged participation in a nationwide earthquake simulation exercise. The drill tested emergency response protocols across the country.

stories.title: EN VIVO | Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026: Sigue el minuto a minuto del ejercicio de este sábado 19 de septiembre

en.title: LIVE | Second 2026 National Drill: Follow minute-by-minute coverage of Saturday, September 19 exercise
en.summary: Mexico's second national earthquake simulation drill took place on September 19 at 12:00 central time. The exercise tested emergency preparedness and response coordination across the country.

stories.title: Trump no tolerará los intentos de frenar el desarrollo de la IA

en.title: Trump will not tolerate attempts to slow AI development
en.summary: The president rejects growing societal skepticism toward artificial intelligence, which has been fueled by warnings about potential dangers to humanity.

stories.title: Planes Premium de Disney+ “puede incluir anuncios”, pero no es tan malo como parece

en.title: Disney+ Premium plans "may include ads," but it's not as bad as it seems
en.summary: The streaming platform faces user complaints about increasingly restrictive measures being implemented on its service.

stories.title: 10 millones de dispositivos y menos de cinco segundos, la carrera de SkyAlert ante un sismo

en.title: 10 million devices and less than five seconds, SkyAlert's race against an earthquake
en.summary: SkyAlert's earthquake alert system uses sensors, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to detect earthquakes and distribute alerts to millions of devices in seconds. The technology analyzes potential impact before sending notifications.

stories.title: Registro telefónico llega a 54.7%, mientras las fallas en plataformas aún complican la vinculación

en.title: Telephone Registration Reaches 54.7%, While Platform Failures Continue to Complicate Linking
en.summary: More than half of active telephone lines are now registered, but technical issues with platforms persist in hindering users from completing the linking process.

stories.title: Tim Hortons reta a Starbucks con tazas de Halloween y se adelanta al vaso de Snoopy

en.title: Tim Hortons challenges Starbucks with Halloween cups and gets ahead of Snoopy glass
en.summary: Tim Hortons launched Halloween-themed cups before Starbucks, with both coffee chains using limited-edition collectible cups as a strategy to attract customers and increase sales.
